Gift.DialogHint: Leave blank and the Gods will decide.

Settings.IntervalHint: How often the gods grant random hero points while a session is active.
Settings.CountHint: How many random players below max receive a point each interval.
Settings.LimitHint: How many hero points each player may gift per session.
Settings.ReminderHint: Show a brief reminder toast when you log in as a GM and no hero point session is active.
Settings.EndOnExitHint: End the running session once the last GM has left. It is applied the next time a GM loads in, and reloading the page does not count as leaving.
Settings.DivineReasonsHint: Add a random funny or god-themed reason to the chat card when the Gods grant hero points on the timer.

FunnyReasons.r01: They looked like they needed a win.
FunnyReasons.r02: A goblin told us it was a good idea.
FunnyReasons.r04: Someone has to balance the cosmic ledger.
FunnyReasons.r05: For emotional damage sustained in the last fight.
FunnyReasons.r06: Because rolling a 1 should come with a refund.
FunnyReasons.r07: The Gods lost a bet and this is the payout.
FunnyReasons.r08: A suspiciously friendly bard vouched for them.
FunnyReasons.r09: They shared their rations without being asked.
FunnyReasons.r10: It was in the stars. Or on a napkin. Hard to tell.
FunnyReasons.r11: Their dramatic monologue was almost worth it.
FunnyReasons.r13: A very persuasive pigeon made the case.
FunnyReasons.r14: For heroically not splitting the party. This time.
FunnyReasons.r16: They've earned it, mostly by surviving their own plans.
FunnyReasons.r17: A minor deity was feeling generous after lunch.
FunnyReasons.r18: For bravely walking into the obviously trapped room.
FunnyReasons.r19: Because the party's healer said please.
FunnyReasons.r20: Fate flipped a coin and it landed on its edge.
FunnyReasons.r21: They petted the dog. Everyone saw.
FunnyReasons.r22: In recognition of an extremely brave misunderstanding.
FunnyReasons.r23: A wizard owed a favor and this was cheaper than gold.
FunnyReasons.r24: Because everyone deserves a second chance, and a third.
FunnyReasons.r25: The tavern keeper vouched for them, loudly.
FunnyReasons.r26: They rolled a natural 1 and handled it with grace.
FunnyReasons.r27: Because the rogue pickpocketed the Gods and left a tip.
FunnyReasons.r28: For asking the right question at the worst possible moment.
FunnyReasons.r29: A passing owlbear gave a thumbs up. Or a paw up.
FunnyReasons.r30: They carried the party's loot and never complained once.
FunnyReasons.r31: For somehow making that plan work.
FunnyReasons.r32: Because the cleric prayed extra hard and with sincerity.
FunnyReasons.r33: Their character sheet was just very well organized.
FunnyReasons.r34: A ghost put in a good word.
FunnyReasons.r35: For keeping a straight face during the negotiation.
FunnyReasons.r36: They remembered the name of the innkeeper's cat.
FunnyReasons.r37: Because the fighter said they'd be careful. They were not.
FunnyReasons.r38: A dragon wouldn't stop staring until someone said yes.
FunnyReasons.r39: For reading the entire scroll out loud.
FunnyReasons.r40: The prophecy was vague, so this seemed safest.
FunnyReasons.r42: Because the party needed one more brave idea.
FunnyReasons.r44: For narrating that critical hit with real flair.
FunnyReasons.r45: Someone owed the narrator a favor.
FunnyReasons.r46: They survived a trap that definitely wasn't their fault.
FunnyReasons.r47: The cosmos shrugged and said sure.
FunnyReasons.r48: For stepping on the obvious pressure plate so nobody else had to.
FunnyReasons.r49: A mysterious stranger paid for it. In pickles.
FunnyReasons.r50: Because it's been a long day and they deserve something nice.

GodReasons.g01: The Gods were watching and, for once, impressed.
GodReasons.g02: A divine coin flip landed in their favor.
GodReasons.g04: The Gods are bored and chose a champion at random.
GodReasons.g05: A minor miracle, delivered via interdimensional courier.
GodReasons.g06: The pantheon held a vote. It was close.
GodReasons.g07: A choir of angels cleared their throat.
GodReasons.g08: The Gods felt a disturbance in the plot and corrected it.
GodReasons.g09: Divine providence, plus a clerical error in their favor.
GodReasons.g10: Lady Luck smiled. Then winked. Then smiled again.
GodReasons.g11: A god mistook them for someone else and was too proud to take it back.
GodReasons.g13: Destiny was running late, so the Gods improvised.
GodReasons.g14: A prayer, three candles, and a very good snack.
GodReasons.g16: Fate tugged at a thread and this fell out.
GodReasons.g17: The stars aligned. Mostly. Close enough.
GodReasons.g18: A deity sneezed and a blessing came out.
GodReasons.g19: The Gods are fond of underdogs and these ones are doing great.
GodReasons.g20: An ancient and unreasonable rule of the universe.
